Title: More of the same card on one Minion.

Messages.Author: Victor Poederbach
Messages.Body:
Hi There,

I was wondering whether it is possible to play for example two blood
dolls or two flak jackets on the same vampire.

Any answers?

Thanks i.a.

Victor.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
vict...@xs4all.nl (Victor Poederbach) writes:
>I was wondering whether it is possible to play for example two blood
>dolls or two flak jackets on the same vampire.

Yes. Everything stacks (except for things which have explicit card text
denying stacking - Laptop, Hawg/Sportbike, errata'ed Fame, etc.)

With two Blood Dolls on the same vampire, you could move two blood
off or two blood on each Master Phase (or one off and one on :-).
